notes: Ethereum mainnet (1). Entire fixed supply is minted to the deploying launch factory. Factory distributes the external 10% swarm allocation, seeds 90% through PoolManager and forwards any seed rounding remainder to economics.remainderTo. No application contracts. Only transfers from the specified mainnet PoolManager are taxed 3%; transfers to it are untaxed. Dividends are PSS, allocated using post-transfer eligible balances. Mandatory pool fee 3000 (0.30%) takes precedence over the earlier 1.25% description. The 1% creator-fee routing to SIMD is an external launchpad responsibility; this token neither configures nor collects it. initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics and actual currency order.
